definitions.K_trace: backend-internal physics trace cutoff, never M or K_geometry

changes_from_DF: declared-noise whitening and discrepancy stop for every stage
recurrent cleanup before full-catalog releases when noise is declared

operations.label: k_1
operations.purpose: Saved BRG frequency prefix; equal frequency weights; compact storage
operations.entry: previous operation completed or exhausted its stage quota
operations.transition: advance on normal/quota return; any hard/numerical failure ends the fit; full real catalog at declared noise discrepancy ends the fit

accuracy_profile.refinement: raise K_trace by 32; raise coefficient window by 32; frontier and endpoint audit only

operations.geometry_update: z + P_K[A(z+h*n)-A(z)], derivative of the complete trial
